queries_run: Flex Ltd business model shift 2026 data center power platform EMS

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 描述 Flex 提供增值履約與正向物流，服務企業、零售、D2C 與市集通路；為既有服務敘述，未見通路結構性轉變的揭露
findings.excerpt: We provide extensive value-added fulfillment and logistics capabilities to reduce lead times while serving the needs of enterprise, retail, direct-to-consumer, and marketplace channels globally.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到 Flex 2026 年銷售通路／分銷層面的結構性變化報導；第三方摘要僅描述商業模式由傳統代工朝資料中心電力與 AI 基礎設施（EMS+Products+Services）移動，屬產品組合轉移而非通路轉移
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks 'How is Flex Accelerating Its Expansion in the Data Center Market?'

channel_business_model_shift.note: 通路/D2C/訂閱化層面查無來源；僅有產品組合轉向資料中心電力的第三方說法（as_of 為推估）。
